grammar.title: The Present Progressive and Formal Register
grammar.explanation:
In a professional context, Spanish often uses the present progressive (estar + gerund) to describe ongoing tasks:

• Estoy preparando el informe. - I am preparing the report.
• Estamos revisando el proyecto. - We are reviewing the project.

Gerund forms: -ar → -ando (trabajando), -er/-ir → -iendo (escribiendo, recibiendo)

Formal workplace expressions:
• Le informo que... - I am informing you that...
• Le adjunto el informe. - I am attaching the report.
• Quedo a su disposición. - I remain at your disposal.
• Atentamente - Sincerely (in emails)
